en: The time when you are a child.
ex: He spent his childhood in a small village.
他在一個小村莊度過童年。

en: Facts or numbers that are collected and used to find information or make decisions.
ex: The scientist collected data from many experiments.
科學家從許多實驗中蒐集資料。

en: A person who is invited to your home or to an event; or a person staying in a hotel.
ex: We have two guests staying with us this weekend.
這個週末有兩位客人住在我們家。

en: To use a telephone to call a number; or the round face of a clock or instrument that shows a measurement.
ex: Dial 119 if there is a fire.
如果發生火災，請撥119。

en: Located in or coming from the north part of a place; or a person from the north.
ex: The northern part of the country is colder in winter.
這個國家北部在冬天比較冷。

en: Worried and a bit afraid about something that is going to happen; or relating to the nerves.
ex: I always feel nervous before an exam.
我考試前總是覺得緊張。

en: The country in East Asia; or fine white or colored pottery used for plates and cups.
ex: The tea was served in beautiful china cups.
茶用美麗的瓷杯盛著。

en: One of the five natural abilities such as sight or hearing; or the meaning of a word; or good judgment; or to feel something.
ex: Dogs have a very good sense of smell.
狗有非常靈敏的嗅覺。

en: To come together in a group; or to bring things together; or to understand something from information.
ex: The students gathered in the school hall for the meeting.
學生們聚集在學校禮堂開會。

en: To control a country or an area with a formal political power; or to direct something.
ex: The king governed the country for forty years.
國王統治這個國家四十年。

en: To say hello to someone when you meet them; or to react to something in a particular way.
ex: The teacher greeted the students at the school gate.
老師在校門口向學生們問好。

en: A soft, wet mixture, such as flour and water, or a sticky substance used to stick things; or to stick something with glue.
ex: Use some paste to stick the picture on the paper.
用一些漿糊把圖片貼在紙上。

en: A book in which you write what happens to you each day.
ex: She writes in her diary every night before bed.
她每晚睡前都寫日記。

en: Who you are; the qualities that make you different from others; or a person's name and details.
ex: Please show your identity card at the entrance.
請在入口處出示你的身分證。

en: To have clothes, shoes or jewelry on your body; or to become thinner from use; or clothing.
ex: She wears a uniform to school every day.
她每天穿制服上學。

en: A small restaurant where you can buy coffee, tea and light meals.
ex: We met at a cafe near the station for coffee.
我們在車站附近的咖啡館碰面喝咖啡。

en: A long walk in the countryside; or to go on such a walk; or a sudden increase in price.
ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
我們去山裡走了一趟長途健行。

en: A man who works in business, especially at a high level.
ex: The businessman flew to Tokyo for a meeting.
那位商人搭飛機去東京開會。

en: A small part of a larger group; or a group of people of a different race or religion from most people.
ex: Only a small minority of students disagreed.
只有一小部分學生不同意。

en: A person or animal that hunts wild animals for food or sport.
ex: The hunter followed the tracks of the deer through the snow.
獵人沿著鹿的足跡穿過雪地。

en: A person who has great skill in something; or to learn something completely; or a man who is in charge.
ex: It takes years to master the piano.
精通鋼琴需要好幾年。

en: To say that you will not do or accept something; or things that are thrown away.
ex: She refused the gift because it was too expensive.
她拒絕了那份禮物，因為太貴重了。

en: The flat part of a TV, computer or phone where you see pictures; or a large white surface at a cinema; or to protect.
ex: Don't stare at the computer screen for too long.
別盯著電腦螢幕看太久。

en: To stop sleeping; or to make someone stop sleeping; or the track behind a moving boat.
ex: I wake up at six o'clock every morning.
我每天早上六點醒來。

en: To move food or drink down your throat; or a small bird with a forked tail that flies fast.
ph: one swallow doesn't make a summer
ex: It hurts to swallow when you have a sore throat.
喉嚨痛的時候吞嚥會痛。

en: A small round red insect with black spots on its back.
ex: A ladybug landed on the green leaf.
一隻瓢蟲停在綠葉上。

en: Covered with rocks or full of rocks; or unsteady and likely to fail.
ex: We walked along a rocky path to the top of the hill.
我們沿著一條多岩石的小路走到山頂。

en: At the time that something happens; or used to ask about time; or as soon as.
ex: When I was young, I lived in the countryside.
我小時候住在鄉下。

en: The quality of being very attractive; or a very attractive woman; or a great advantage.
ex: We admired the beauty of the lake at sunrise.
我們欣賞著日出時湖面的美。

en: A person who does a particular job, especially work with their hands or in a factory.
ex: The workers were building a new bridge.
工人們正在建一座新橋。

en: A door or gate that you go through to get into a place; or the right to enter somewhere.
ex: We waited for him at the entrance of the park.
我們在公園入口等他。

en: A thin, pointed piece of metal used to join pieces of wood; or the hard part at the end of your finger; or to attach with nails.
ph: hit the nail on the head
ex: He used a hammer to drive a nail into the wall.
他用鐵鎚把釘子釘進牆裡。

en: A place where legal cases are decided; or a flat area for playing sports such as tennis; or an open space in a building.
ex: They played tennis on the court every Saturday.
他們每個星期六都在球場打網球。

en: A large animal like a monkey with no tail, such as a gorilla or chimpanzee.
ex: Gorillas and chimpanzees are both types of ape.
大猩猩和黑猩猩都是猿類。

en: To heat a liquid until it bubbles; or to cook food in boiling water; or to feel very angry.
ex: Boil the water before you make tea.
泡茶之前先把水煮開。

en: Harm or injury that makes something less valuable or useful; or to cause harm to something.
ex: The storm caused a lot of damage to the town.
暴風雨對小鎮造成了很大的損害。

en: The pointed top of a mountain; or the highest or best point of something.
ex: We reached the peak of the mountain before sunset.
我們在日落前登上山頂。

en: A word used to talk about the future; or the power to decide what you do; or a legal paper that says who gets your property when you die.
ex: She has a strong will and never gives up.
她意志堅強，從不放棄。

en: To look at something very carefully; or to test someone's knowledge; or to check someone's health.
ex: The doctor examined the boy's throat.
醫生檢查了男孩的喉嚨。

en: A person in charge of a department or a company; or a person who tells actors how to act in a film or play.
ex: The director of the film won a big prize.
那部電影的導演贏得了一個大獎。
